title: Flywheel — Fluctuation of Energy & Speed
subtitle: This week is where the numbers come in. You'll calculate exactly how much energy the flywheel stores, how much the speed fluctuates, and how to size a flywheel for a given engine. The coefficient of fluctuation of energy and coefficient of fluctuation of speed are the two key numbers.
learningOutcome: This week is where the numbers come in. You'll calculate exactly how much energy the flywheel stores, how much the speed fluctuates, and how to size a flywheel for a given engine. The coefficient of fluctuation of energy and coefficient of fluctuation of speed are the two key numbers.

content.text: The turning moment diagram shows areas above and below the mean torque line. Areas above mean the engine is producing more than needed (storing energy in flywheel). Areas below mean the flywheel is releasing energy. The difference between the maximum and minimum energy levels during a cycle is called the maximum fluctuation of energy, ΔE.

items: ΔE = ½I(ω₁² − ω₂²) = Iω(ω₁ − ω₂) = Iω² · Cs

content.text: I = mass moment of inertia (kg·m²) · ω = mean angular speed (rad/s) · ω₁ = max speed · ω₂ = min speed · Cs = coefficient of fluctuation of speed

items: or Cs = 2(ω₁ − ω₂) / (ω₁ + ω₂) [when given in rad/s]
or Cs = 2(v₁ − v₂) / (v₁ + v₂) [when given as linear velocity]

content.text: N₁ = max speed (rpm) · N₂ = min speed (rpm) · Coefficient of Steadiness = 1/Cs
ΔE = maximum fluctuation of energy · I·ω² = total work done per cycle
Energy stored in flywheel & moment of inertia
m = mass of flywheel (kg) · k = radius of gyration (m) · I = mk² (kg·m²)
Tₘ = mean torque (N·m) · ω = angular speed (rad/s) · N = speed (rpm)

Common mistake — When tracking energy on the TMD, students forget that energy at A = 0 (set as reference). Energy ACCUMULATES as you add areas. Areas above mean line are positive (+), areas below are negative (−). Get one sign wrong and your ΔE is totally wrong.

items: • Given a TMD with areas, find ΔE (max fluctuation of energy) and coefficient of fluctuation of energy C_E.
• Calculate coefficient of fluctuation of speed C_s given N₁, N₂ or ω₁, ω₂.
• Find the energy stored in a flywheel given mass and radius of gyration. Common exam Q
